Select assay ChEMBL ID, target type, tax ID, canonical SMILES, molecule ChEMBL ID, standard type, and pChEMBL value for IC50 activities against human single-protein target CHEMBL3663 (Growth factor receptor-bound protein 2). Join molecule_dictionary to activities, assays, and target_dictionary. Inner join compound_structures to require canonical SMILES. Filter by target chembl_id CHEMBL3663, standard_type IC50, standard_relation equals, and pChEMBL value not null. Order results by molecule ChEMBL ID and assay ChEMBL ID. Limit to 1000 rows.
